PM Modi Concludes Indonesia Visit, Strengthens Ties and Visits Temple

Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded a three-day state visit to Indonesia, where he met with President Prabowo Subianto to strengthen bilateral ties. The leaders agreed to enhance cooperation in defense, maritime collaboration, and digital innovation, with 14 pacts signed. During the visit, PM Modi also visited the Prambanan Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and announced India's assistance in its restoration using the anastylosis technique, with work scheduled to begin in 2026-27. Indonesia honored PM Modi with its highest civilian award, and fighter jets escorted his aircraft as he departed for Australia.
